## Summary

What changed, and which project folder it touches.

## Why

The failure, the gap, or the teaching point. Link the issue if one exists.

## Checks

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] I ran the notebook I changed, or the change is documentation only.
- [ ] Paths are relative `data/` paths, not `/content/` or a local absolute path.
- [ ] No checkpoint, secret, or non-redistributable file is included.
- [ ] Saved scores are still valid, or I updated the README and marked the new run.

## Score impact

State "unchanged" or give the old score, the new score, and the library versions.

## Dataset

State "none" or name the file, its source, and why it may be committed.
